model_annotation: This image displays a "pie of pie" chart titled "粘合式 'an' 结构" (Adhesive "an" structure), which represents the distribution of specific linguistic structures and further breaks down one of those categories. The visualization consists of a primary pie chart on the left with two slices and a secondary pie chart on the right, also with two slices, connected to the primary chart by diverging lines. In the primary chart, the largest slice is colored yellow, labeled "单音形容词+单音名词" (Monosyllabic adjective + monosyllabic noun), and accounts for 229 cases or 69.39%. The second slice is blue, labeled "双音形容词+单音名词" (Disyllabic adjective + monosyllabic noun), representing 101 cases or 30.61%. The yellow slice is visually emphasized by connecting lines that expand it into the secondary pie chart on the right. This secondary chart details the breakdown of the yellow category into an orange slice labeled "“的” 字只隐不现" (The word "de" is only hidden and does not appear) at 81.66%, and a smaller green slice labeled "“的” 字只现不隐" (The word "de" only appears and is not hidden) at 18.34%. In both charts, the slices are visually ordered such that the significantly larger proportion occupies the upper and rightward sections of the circle. Text labels, case counts, and percentage values are placed directly inside or immediately adjacent to their respective slices. Additionally, a small legend is located at the bottom center of the image, displaying blue, orange, and green squares corresponding to the numbers 1, 2, and 3, respectively.
